Callout.Name: Hunters - Land Without Permission
Callout.Message: Two hunters on land without permission.
Callout.Advisory: Both armed, rifles slung, no shots fired.

Script.Line: We came over from the next valley and we read the map wrong.
We have not taken a shot all morning. Not one.
The rifles are coming down. Nobody needs to get excited.

Lines.Approach: They are the wrong side of the fence line with rifles and they know it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
